qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Contractually locked aftermarket Risk and Revenue Sharing Partnerships (RRSPs) on commercial aircraft engines (GTF, GEnx, Trent) provide long-term high-margin aftermarket toll booth revenues with pricing power indexed above inflation.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 6 (FCF conversion < 80% and negative multi-year statutory earnings). GKN Aerospace engine RRSP toll booth has strong sole-source positions, but negative multi-year statutory earnings (£-1.02B in 2023, £-49M in 2024) and cash outflows from GTF powdered metal fleet inspections fail the Munger cash compounding and balance sheet peace-of-mind test.
qualitative.evidence: Statutory net income was negative across 2022 (-£308M), 2023 (-£1,020M), and 2024 (-£49M) before recovering to £370M in 2025. Free cash flow was negative in 2023 and 2024 (-£74M) before turning positive to £125M in 2025, failing the multi-year 80% FCF conversion requirement. Significant cash outflows required for Pratt & Whitney GTF engine fleet inspections and airline compensation.

evaluation_metadata.verdict: Rejected – G6 Cash & Fortress Balance Sheet
